description: Defines the InputEventsGenerator class for handling Android input events and translating them into Starboard application events, including processing pointer, joystick, and DPad events, with internal state for device mapping and input values.

classes.name: InputEventsGenerator
classes.description: Handles conversion of Android input events to Starboard application events, manages device input states, and processes various input types.

methods.name: InputEventsGenerator
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a window handle.

methods.name: CreateInputEventsFromGameActivityEvent
methods.description: Converts a GameActivity input event (motion or key) into Starboard events.

methods.name: CreateInputEventsFromSbKey
methods.description: Creates input events from an SbKey, for accessibility injection.

methods.name: UpdateDeviceFlatMapIfNecessary
methods.description: Updates device mapping for input device.

methods.name: ProcessFallbackDPadEvent
methods.description: Handles DPad events, synthesizing key events if needed.

methods.name: UpdateHatValuesAndPossiblySynthesizeKeyEvents
methods.description: Updates hat (DPad) values and generates key events.
